blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Nxled completed an elimination round sweep after beating ZUS Coffee, 25-21, 25-20, 20-25, 25-19, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at Philsports Arena. MJ Phillips led the collective effort with 16 points, while Brooke Van Sickle backstopped her with 14 points and 12 excellent receptions to enter the semis with an 8-0 record. “We are happy that we didn’t lose a single game but to be clear, today, the third set was a wake-up call.
